I farm a small wheat plot here in Tigray, only a tiny piece of land, but wheat needs feeding if I want a decent harvest. I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative if it arrives in time — even a small amount helps on this plot. I cannot afford the full package nor improved seed this season, so I will save seed from last year and spread the manure from my animals on the field. My family will do most of the work; weeding I may need a neighbor's hand for a day or two.
